title: Show brief information for a specific hardware component
summary: Use hwinfo with the --short flag to get a concise, one-line summary of a specific hardware component instead of the full detailed output.

steps.explain: Run hwinfo with the --short flag to display a succinct summary of the specified hardware component.

placeholders.name: COMPONENT
placeholders.description: The hardware component to query, e.g., cpu, memory, disk, gfxcard, network, usb, pci, keyboard, mouse, monitor, sound, fingerprint.
